name: My Exclusive Client
overview:
The story of a girl on the brink of crisis becoming a call-girl to save herself.

Jennifer, the star columnist of Vanity Queen magazine, finds herself on the brink of an unexpected layoff crisis. Her only hope of retaining her position is to craft a captivating story about a call-girl, a predicament thrust upon her by her cold, expressionless boss, Charlie. Determined to gather firsthand experience for her article, she ventures into the heart of a club. There, she encounters a mysterious masked man, who offers her to serve him exclusively. Little does she know, this enigmatic client is none other than her arch-nemesis, Charlie...
